title: AI meets creativity: How generative AI is reshaping ad creative workflows

facts.fact: The StackAdapt blog article 'AI meets creativity: How generative AI is reshaping ad creative workflows' was published on January 28, 2025.
According to StackAdapt Creative Project Manager James Targett, the team can produce 50 headlines in about the time it historically took to produce one, a vendor-reported productivity claim.
facts.quote: “We can produce 50 headlines as quickly as we could historically produce one,” says James Targett, Creative Project Manager at StackAdapt.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's Targett states that, based on the company's tracking of CTR, AI-generated copy often outperforms client-supplied and internally written content, but the page gives no numeric CTR figures.
facts.quote: We’ve tracked [performance metrics](https://www.stackadapt.com/resources/blog/programmatic-kpis-explained) like click-through rates (CTR), and AI-generated copy often outperforms client-supplied and internally written content.

facts.fact: The article states that Coca-Cola and Toys 'R' Us ad campaigns faced backlash for lacking a 'human touch,' citing Forbes coverage from 2024.
facts.quote: Some campaigns, like those from [Coca-Cola](https://www.forbes.com/sites/danidiplacido/2024/11/16/coca-colas-ai-generated-ad-controversy-explained/) and [Toys “R” Us](https://www.forbes.com/sites/danidiplacido/2024/06/26/the-toys-r-us-ai-generated-ad-controversy-explained/), faced backlash for lacking a “human touch.”
